ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Windows Trace ETW Session Tamper Via Logman.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "logman" utility in order to disable or delete Windows trace sessions

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\logman\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Logman\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*stop\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*delete\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Circular\\ Kernel\\ Context\\ Logger.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*EventLog\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SYSMON\\ TRACE.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SysmonDnsEtwSession.*")))
